build_VitStereoPointmapHead: build a VitStereoPointmapHead decode head with configurable deconv, upsample conv, and conv layer sequences
create_make_conv_layers: create convolutional layers with InstanceNorm2d and SiLU activation from channel and kernel size sequences
create_make_upsample_conv_layers: create upsample conv layers with bicubic 2x upsampling followed by Conv2d, InstanceNorm2d, and SiLU
create_make_deconv_layers: create deconvolutional layers with transposed convolution, InstanceNorm2d, and SiLU for kernel sizes 2, 3, or 4
run_loss_by_feat: run loss computation on segmentation logits against ground truth depth maps with optional pointmap consistency loss
